nights.title: Human Nature: Back To The Sound Of Motown
nights.name: Human Nature
nights.extract: Human Nature are an Australian pop vocal group which formed in 1989. They are a quartet featuring Toby Allen, Phil Burton and brothers, Andrew and Mike Tierney. Originally they were established as a doo-wop group called the 4 Trax, when the members were schoolmates.
